title: Coding Activity YAML
description: Schema for a coding activity: an OpenAI-compatible coding endpoint an external coding agent (e.g. little-coder) points at.

id.description: Short machine-readable activity id, e.g. beginner-typescript.

name.description: Optional human-readable label (not shown to the student).

title.description: Optional label shown to the student on the /<code> connection page.

fragment_files.description: Optional fragment libraries this activity pulls shared prompt fragments from.

text_files.description: Optional plain-text files (markdown / source, e.g. a sample solution) embedded verbatim into instructions via {{file "alias"}} markers.

instructions.description: The assistant's system prompt. SERVER-ONLY: never sent to the browser or the coding agent, and appended AFTER the coding tool's own prompt (so the teacher has the final word). Constrain the assistant to what your class has learned. When any fragment_files or text_files are declared it is a Handlebars template: place fragments inline with {{fragment "alias.id" …}} and embed text files with {{file "alias"}} (optionally {{file "alias" from=10 to=40}} for a line range; escape a literal {{ as \{{).

model.description: The model that answers. SERVER-ONLY and PINNED: the proxy always uses this model and ignores whatever model the coding agent sends.

provider.description: The LLM provider serving the model. For Azure Foundry, model is the deployment name.

llm.description: The pinned model and provider that answer coding requests.

id.description: Local alias for this library, used before the dot in `{{fragment "alias.id"}}`. Must not contain a dot.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL or relative path to the fragment library.

fragmentFileRef.description: A reference to a fragment library by alias + URL.

id.description: Local alias for this text file, used in `{{file "alias"}}`. Must not contain a dot.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL or relative path to the plain-text file.

textFileRef.description: A reference to a plain-text file (markdown / source) by alias + URL.
